The Deputy Chief Engineer (Construction), N.F. Railway

 Versus
Sri Manik Miah and others
 ----Respondent(s)
L.A. App. No.04 of 2022 The Deputy Chief Engineer (Construction), N.F. Railway
----Appellant(s) Versus Sri Durgapada Roy and another
----Respondent(s) For Appellant(s) : Mr. Asutosh De, Advocate.
For Respondent(s) : None.
Hon'Ble The Chief Justice(Acting) Date of hearing and judgment : 17th January, 2023.
JUDGMENT & ORDER(ORAL) Heard Mr. Asutosh De, learned counsel appearing for the appellant-N.F. Railway.
None appears for the respondents.
These appeals arise in common background.
Since facts and issues are identical, they have been heard together and would be disposed of by this common judgment.

[2] The Government of Tripura had acquired the land measuring 0.21 acres under plot No.2657/22940, 2658/22939, 2658/22941 of khatian No.5462 under Mouja-Bishalgarh,
Sub-Division-Bishalgarh, Sepahijala District belonging to the claimants by a notification No.F.09(05)/REV/ACQ/XIV/11 dated 27.07.2011 for the purpose of construction of "New Rail Line"
from Agartala to Sabroom.

The L.A. Collector, West Tripura awarded an amount of Rs.8,14,803/-
for the acquired land including all statutory benefits.

Dissatisfied with the same, the claimants filed a reference before learned L.A. Judge who after hearing both sides and appreciating evidence on record awarded an amount of Rs.15,00,000/- per kani for the acquired land.
Aggrieved thereby, the appellant-N.F. Railway preferred this appeal.
Hence, this case.

[3] The Government of Tripura had acquired the land measuring 0.03 acres under plot No.2538/23970 of khatian No.6532 of Mouja- Bishalgarh, Sub-Division-Bishalgarh, Sepahijala District belonging to the claimant by a notification No.F.09(05)/REV/ACQ/XIV/11 dated 27.07.2011 for the purpose of construction of "New Rail Line"
from Agartala to Sabroom.
